places.getThere: Fly to Chu Lai (VCL) or take the train to Quang Ngai, drive ~40 min to Sa Ky port, then a ~30-min speedboat to the island.

days.title: To the big island
days.morning: Speedboat from Sa Ky port (~30 min), check in and rent a scooter.
days.afternoon: Hang pagoda and To Vo arch – wait for sunset.
days.evening: Garlic salad and rock snails at the Ly Son night market.

days.title: Thoi Loi peak
days.morning: Climb Thoi Loi for sunrise over the old crater.
days.afternoon: Am Linh Tu and the Hoang Sa – Bac Hai flotilla exhibition house.
days.evening: Fresh seafood and sea urchin porridge.

days.title: Little Island
days.morning: Boat to Little Island and swim at Hang beach.
days.afternoon: Snorkel the corals and walk around the islet.
days.evening: Back on the big island, stroll the garlic fields at dusk.

days.title: Hang Cau and the cliffs
days.morning: Hang Cau with its layered volcanic cliffs.
days.afternoon: The national flagpole; buy single-clove garlic as gifts.

days.title: Back to the mainland
days.morning: Sunrise from the pier, then the boat back to Sa Ky.
days.afternoon: Son My memorial site and goby fish from the Tra river.
days.evening: Continue to Quang Ngai or Da Nang.
